comment: Fixture types of the game's rooms (pc/docs/Fixture_Catalog.md). Hashes and numbers only; built from the user's disc by pc/tools/fixture_scan.py, then edited by hand or in the editor.

candle_flame.description: candle flame only (holder is room mesh)

torch_flame.description: torch flame only (holder is room mesh)

brazier.description: brazier / fire bowl on a stand

fireplace.description: fireplace / hearth / campfire (large flame at floor level)

fire_sprite.description: large fire sprite only (hearth is room mesh)

street_lantern.description: glass street lantern (flame and glowing panes)

glass_lamp.description: glass lantern (glowing panes, no flame sprite)

animated_surface.description: animated surface (liquid / texture animation, no glow)
